verses.original: אֶת־ אֱלֹהִים֙ וַיִּזְכֹּ֤ר נֹ֔חַ וְאֵ֤ת כָּל־ הַֽחַיָּה֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּ֖וֹ בַּתֵּבָ֑ה אֱלֹהִ֥ים ר֙וּחַ֙ וַיַּעֲבֵ֨ר עַל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ הַמָּֽיִם׃ וַיָּשֹׁ֖כּוּ
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yiz·kōr nō·aḥ wə·’êṯ kāl- ha·ḥay·yāh wə·’eṯ- kāl- hab·bə·hê·māh ’ă·šer ’it·tōw bat·tê·ḇāh ’ĕ·lō·hîm rū·aḥ way·ya·‘ă·ḇêr ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ ham·mā·yim way·yā·šōk·kū
verses.literal: But God remembered Noah - and all the animals and - livestock that were with him in the ark And God sent a wind . . . over the earth and the waters began to subside

verses.original: מַעְיְנֹ֣ת תְּה֔וֹם וַֽאֲרֻבֹּ֖ת הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַיִּסָּֽכְרוּ֙ הַגֶּ֖שֶׁם מִן־ הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃ וַיִּכָּלֵ֥א
verses.transliteration: ma‘·yə·nōṯ tə·hō·wm wa·’ă·rub·bōṯ haš·šā·mā·yim way·yis·sā·ḵə·rū hag·ge·šem min- haš·šā·mā·yim way·yik·kā·lê
verses.literal: The springs of the deep and the floodgates of the heavens were closed and the rain from the sky was restrained

verses.original: הַמַּ֛יִם וַיָּשֻׁ֧בוּ הָל֣וֹךְ וָשׁ֑וֹב מֵעַ֥ל הָאָ֖רֶץ מִקְצֵ֕ה וּמְאַ֖ת חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים יֽוֹם׃ הַמַּ֔יִם וַיַּחְסְר֣וּ
verses.transliteration: ham·ma·yim way·yā·šu·ḇū hā·lō·wḵ wā·šō·wḇ mê·‘al hā·’ā·reṣ miq·ṣêh ū·mə·’aṯ ḥă·miš·šîm yō·wm ham·ma·yim way·yaḥ·sə·rū
verses.literal: The waters receded steadily . . . from the earth and after 150 . . . days the waters had gone down

verses.original: בְּשִׁבְעָה־ עָשָׂ֥ר י֖וֹם לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַתֵּבָה֙ וַתָּ֤נַח עַ֖ל הָרֵ֥י אֲרָרָֽט׃
verses.transliteration: bə·šiḇ·‘āh- ‘ā·śār yō·wm la·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šə·ḇî·‘î ba·ḥō·ḏeš hat·tê·ḇāh wat·tā·naḥ ‘al hā·rê ’ă·rā·rāṭ
verses.literal: On the seventeenth . . . day - of the seventh month the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat

verses.original: וְהַמַּ֗יִם הָיוּ֙ הָל֣וֹךְ וְחָס֔וֹר עַ֖ד הָֽעֲשִׂירִ֑י הַחֹ֣דֶשׁ בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ בָּֽעֲשִׂירִי֙ רָאשֵׁ֥י הֶֽהָרִֽים׃ נִרְא֖וּ
verses.transliteration: wə·ham·ma·yim hā·yū hā·lō·wḵ wə·ḥā·sō·wr ‘aḏ hā·‘ă·śî·rî ha·ḥō·ḏeš bə·’e·ḥāḏ la·ḥō·ḏeš bā·‘ă·śî·rî rā·šê he·hā·rîm nir·’ū
verses.literal: And the waters . . . continued to recede until the tenth month [and] on the first day of the tenth month the tops of the mountains became visible

verses.original: וַֽיְהִ֕י מִקֵּ֖ץ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֑וֹם נֹ֔חַ אֶת־ וַיִּפְתַּ֣ח חַלּ֥וֹן אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה׃ הַתֵּבָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: way·hî miq·qêṣ ’ar·bā·‘îm yō·wm nō·aḥ ’eṯ- way·yip̄·taḥ ḥal·lō·wn ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh hat·tê·ḇāh
verses.literal: - After forty days Noah - opened the window - he had made in the ark

verses.original: וַיְשַׁלַּ֖ח אֶת־ הָֽעֹרֵ֑ב וַיֵּצֵ֤א יָצוֹא֙ וָשׁ֔וֹב עַד־ הַמַּ֖יִם יְבֹ֥שֶׁת מֵעַ֥ל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·šal·laḥ ’eṯ- hā·‘ō·rêḇ way·yê·ṣê yā·ṣō·w wā·šō·wḇ ‘aḏ- ham·ma·yim yə·ḇō·šeṯ mê·‘al hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: and sent out - a raven It kept flying back and forth . . . . . . until the waters had dried up from the earth

verses.original: וַיְשַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־ מֵאִתּ֑וֹ הַיּוֹנָ֖ה לִרְאוֹת֙ הַמַּ֔יִם הֲקַ֣לּוּ מֵעַ֖ל פְּנֵ֥י הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·šal·laḥ ’eṯ- mê·’it·tōw hay·yō·w·nāh lir·’ō·wṯ ham·ma·yim hă·qal·lū mê·‘al pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: Then [Noah] sent out - - a dove to see if the waters had receded from the surface of the ground

verses.original: הַיּוֹנָ֨ה מָצְאָה֩ וְלֹֽא־ מָנ֜וֹחַ לְכַף־ רַגְלָ֗הּ וַתָּ֤שָׁב אֵלָיו֙ אֶל־ הַתֵּבָ֔ה כִּי־ מַ֖יִם עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י כָל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח יָדוֹ֙ וַיִּקָּחֶ֔הָ וַיָּבֵ֥א אֹתָ֛הּ אֵלָ֖יו אֶל־ הַתֵּבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hay·yō·w·nāh mā·ṣə·’āh wə·lō- mā·nō·w·aḥ lə·ḵap̄- raḡ·lāh wat·tā·šāḇ ’ê·lāw ’el- hat·tê·ḇāh kî- ma·yim ‘al- pə·nê ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ way·yiš·laḥ yā·ḏōw way·yiq·qā·ḥe·hā way·yā·ḇê ’ō·ṯāh ’ê·lāw ’el- hat·tê·ḇāh
verses.literal: But the dove found no place to rest her foot . . . and she returned to him in the ark because the waters [were still] covering the surface of all the earth So he reached out his hand . . . and brought her back inside the ark

verses.original: וַיָּ֣חֶל ע֔וֹד שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲחֵרִ֑ים יָמִ֖ים וַיֹּ֛סֶף שַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־ הַיּוֹנָ֖ה מִן־ הַתֵּבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḥel ‘ō·wḏ šiḇ·‘aṯ ’ă·ḥê·rîm yā·mîm way·yō·sep̄ šal·laḥ ’eṯ- hay·yō·w·nāh min- hat·tê·ḇāh
verses.literal: [Noah] waited . . . seven more days and again sent out - the dove from the ark

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֥ה הַיּוֹנָה֙ וַתָּבֹ֨א אֵלָ֤יו לְעֵ֣ת עֶ֔רֶב טָרָ֣ף זַ֖יִת עֲלֵה־ בְּפִ֑יהָ נֹ֔חַ וַיֵּ֣דַע כִּי־ הַמַּ֖יִם קַ֥לּוּ מֵעַ֥ל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh hay·yō·w·nāh wat·tā·ḇō ’ê·lāw lə·‘êṯ ‘e·reḇ ṭā·rāp̄ za·yiṯ ‘ă·lêh- bə·p̄î·hā nō·aḥ way·yê·ḏa‘ kî- ham·ma·yim qal·lū mê·‘al hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: And behold the dove returned to him in the evening . . . with a freshly plucked olive leaf in her beak So Noah knew that the waters had receded from the earth

verses.original: וַיִּיָּ֣חֶל ע֔וֹד שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲחֵרִ֑ים יָמִ֖ים וַיְשַׁלַּח֙ אֶת־ הַיּוֹנָ֔ה יָסְפָ֥ה עֽוֹד׃ וְלֹֽא־ שׁוּב־ אֵלָ֖יו
verses.transliteration: way·yî·yā·ḥel ‘ō·wḏ šiḇ·‘aṯ ’ă·ḥê·rîm yā·mîm way·šal·laḥ ’eṯ- hay·yō·w·nāh yā·sə·p̄āh ‘ō·wḏ wə·lō- šūḇ- ’ê·lāw
verses.literal: [And] Noah waited . . . seven more days and sent out - the dove {again} but this time . . . . . . she did not return to him

verses.original: וַֽ֠יְהִי וְשֵׁשׁ־ מֵא֜וֹת בְּאַחַ֨ת שָׁנָ֗ה בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ בָּֽרִאשׁוֹן֙ הַמַּ֖יִם חָֽרְב֥וּ מֵעַ֣ל הָאָ֑רֶץ נֹ֙חַ֙ אֶת־ וַיָּ֤סַר מִכְסֵ֣ה הַתֵּבָ֔ה וַיַּ֕רְא וְהִנֵּ֥ה פְּנֵ֥י הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃ חָֽרְב֖וּ
verses.transliteration: way·hî wə·šêš- mê·’ō·wṯ bə·’a·ḥaṯ šā·nāh bə·’e·ḥāḏ la·ḥō·ḏeš bā·ri·šō·wn ham·ma·yim ḥā·rə·ḇū mê·‘al hā·’ā·reṣ nō·aḥ ’eṯ- way·yā·sar miḵ·sêh hat·tê·ḇāh way·yar wə·hin·nêh pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ḥā·rə·ḇū
verses.literal: - In [Noah’s] six hundred and first year on the first day of the first month the waters had dried up from the earth So Noah - removed the covering from the ark and saw . . . that the surface of the ground was dry

verses.original: בְּשִׁבְעָ֧ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֛ים י֖וֹם לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י וּבַחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ הָאָֽרֶץ׃ס יָבְשָׁ֖ה
verses.transliteration: bə·šiḇ·‘āh wə·‘eś·rîm yō·wm la·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šê·nî ū·ḇa·ḥō·ḏeš hā·’ā·reṣ yā·ḇə·šāh
verses.literal: By the twenty-seventh . . . day . . . of the second month the earth was fully dry

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֖ים וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ נֹ֥חַ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·ḏab·bêr ’el- nō·aḥ lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then God said to Noah . . .

verses.original: צֵ֖א מִן־ הַתֵּבָ֑ה אַתָּ֕ה וְאִשְׁתְּךָ֛ אִתָּֽךְ׃ וּבָנֶ֥יךָ בָנֶ֖יךָ וּנְשֵֽׁי־
verses.transliteration: ṣê min- hat·tê·ḇāh ’at·tāh wə·’iš·tə·ḵā ’it·tāḵ ū·ḇā·ne·ḵā ḇā·ne·ḵā ū·nə·šê-
verses.literal: Come out of the ark you and your wife along with your sons and [their] wives

verses.original: הוֹצֵא אִתָּ֑ךְ כָּל־ הַחַיָּ֨ה מִכָּל־ בָּשָׂ֗ר אֲשֶֽׁר־ אִתְּךָ֜ בָּע֧וֹף וּבַבְּהֵמָ֛ה וּבְכָל־ הָרֶ֛מֶשׂ הָרֹמֵ֥שׂ עַל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ וְשָֽׁרְצ֣וּ בָאָ֔רֶץ וּפָר֥וּ וְרָב֖וּ עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·ṣē ’it·tāḵ kāl- ha·ḥay·yāh mik·kāl bā·śār ’ă·šer- ’it·tə·ḵā bā·‘ō·wp̄ ū·ḇab·bə·hê·māh ū·ḇə·ḵāl hā·re·meś hā·rō·mêś ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·šā·rə·ṣū ḇā·’ā·reṣ ū·p̄ā·rū wə·rā·ḇū ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Bring out . . . all the living creatures . . . . . . that are with you birds livestock and everything - that crawls upon the ground so that they can spread out over the earth and be fruitful and multiply upon [it]

verses.original: נֹ֑חַ וַיֵּ֖צֵא־ אִתּֽוֹ׃ וּבָנָ֛יו וְאִשְׁתּ֥וֹ בָנָ֖יו וּנְשֵֽׁי־
verses.transliteration: nō·aḥ way·yê·ṣê- ’it·tōw ū·ḇā·nāw wə·’iš·tōw ḇā·nāw ū·nə·šê-
verses.literal: So Noah came out along with his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives

verses.original: כָּל־ הַֽחַיָּ֗ה כָּל־ הָרֶ֙מֶשׂ֙ וְכָל־ הָע֔וֹף כֹּ֖ל רוֹמֵ֣שׂ עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ יָצְא֖וּ מִן־ הַתֵּבָֽה׃ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם
verses.transliteration: kāl- ha·ḥay·yāh kāl- hā·re·meś wə·ḵāl hā·‘ō·wp̄ kōl rō·w·mêś ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ yā·ṣə·’ū min- hat·tê·ḇāh lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: Every living creature every creeping thing and every bird everything that moves upon the earth came out of the ark kind by kind

verses.original: נֹ֛חַ וַיִּ֥בֶן מִזְבֵּ֖חַ לַֽיהוָ֑ה וַיִּקַּ֞ח מִכֹּ֣ל׀ הַטְּהוֹרָ֗ה הַבְּהֵמָ֣ה וּמִכֹּל֙ הַטָּהֹ֔ר הָע֣וֹף וַיַּ֥עַל עֹלֹ֖ת בַּמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: nō·aḥ way·yi·ḇen miz·bê·aḥ Yah·weh way·yiq·qaḥ mik·kōl haṭ·ṭə·hō·w·rāh hab·bə·hê·māh ū·mik·kōl haṭ·ṭā·hōr hā·‘ō·wp̄ way·ya·‘al ‘ō·lōṯ bam·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: Then Noah built an altar to the LORD And taking from every kind of clean animal and clean bird he offered burnt offerings on the altar

verses.original: יְהוָה֮ אֶת־ וַיָּ֣רַח הַנִּיחֹחַ֒ רֵ֣יחַ יְהוָ֜ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל־ לִבּ֗וֹ לֹֽא־ אֹ֠סִף ע֤וֹד אֶת־ לְקַלֵּ֨ל הָֽאֲדָמָה֙ בַּעֲב֣וּר הָֽאָדָ֔ם כִּ֠י יֵ֣צֶר הָאָדָ֛ם לֵ֧ב רַ֖ע מִנְּעֻרָ֑יו וְלֹֽא־ אֹסִ֥ף ע֛וֹד לְהַכּ֥וֹת אֶת־ כָּל־ חַ֖י כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִֽׂיתִי׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’eṯ- way·yā·raḥ han·nî·ḥō·aḥ rê·aḥ Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’el- lib·bōw lō- ’ō·sip̄ ‘ō·wḏ ’eṯ- lə·qal·lêl hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ba·‘ă·ḇūr hā·’ā·ḏām kî yê·ṣer hā·’ā·ḏām lêḇ ra‘ min·nə·‘u·rāw wə·lō- ’ō·sip̄ ‘ō·wḏ lə·hak·kō·wṯ ’eṯ- kāl- ḥay ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯî
verses.literal: When the LORD - smelled the pleasing aroma He said in His heart Never again . . . . . . - will I curse the ground because of man even though every inclination of [his] heart is evil from his youth And never again . . . will I destroy - all living creatures as I have done

verses.original: עֹ֖ד כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ יְמֵ֣י זֶ֡רַע וְ֠קָצִיר וְקֹ֨ר וָחֹ֜ם וְקַ֧יִץ וָחֹ֛רֶף וְי֥וֹם וָלַ֖יְלָה לֹ֥א יִשְׁבֹּֽתוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ōḏ kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ yə·mê ze·ra‘ wə·qā·ṣîr wə·qōr wā·ḥōm wə·qa·yiṣ wā·ḥō·rep̄ wə·yō·wm wā·lay·lāh lō yiš·bō·ṯū
verses.literal: As long as . . . the earth endures seedtime and harvest cold and heat summer and winter day and night shall never cease
